segments.text: V. 17, 18. Our LORD here affirms of all the Apoſtles (for the Queſtion is equivalent to an Affirmation) That their hearts were hardened; that having eyes they ſaw not, having ears they heard not; that they did not conſider, neither underſtand: The very ſame Expreſſions that occur in the 13th of St. Matthew. And yet it is certain, they were not judicially hardened. Therefore all theſe ſtrong Expreſſions, do not neceſſarily import any thing more, than the preſent Want of ſpiritual Underſtanding.
